failure_dispositions.SEMANTIC_FAIL: Any GPU golden/optimized causal-state, event, counter, or continuation mismatch. Stop batch expansion and repair at G1/G2.
failure_dispositions.CAUSAL_SENTINEL_FAIL: Any enabled capability lacks its named counter and downstream canonical witness. Stop performance claims.
failure_dispositions.RNG_ADDRESS_FAIL: Any collision, overflow, forbidden launch-coordinate dependency, or K/B partition dependence. Stop execution expansion.
failure_dispositions.CHECKPOINT_FAIL: Missing, unknown, corrupt, torn, incomplete, or non-absolute checkpoint state. Fail before publication and resume.
failure_dispositions.VRAM_FAIL: Measured exact-artifact peak exceeds 1 GiB, violates 25 percent headroom, or grows with total horizon. Retain as negative evidence and redesign.
failure_dispositions.PERFORMANCE_NEGATIVE: The best exact admitted P256 Full Evolution batch is below 446719.311515986800 world-ticks/s. Retain all measurements and enter recovery; never mark PASS.
failure_dispositions.WORKHORSE_ENVELOPE_NEGATIVE: A larger shape fails exact B1/K1 compile, admission, semantics, or continuation. Retain the first exact limit and continue every smaller shape; never reduce capabilities or relabel the result.
failure_dispositions.DEVICE_OUT_OF_ENVELOPE: Built artifact, SM, driver, runtime, or toolchain lies outside the frozen device envelope. Require targeted device delta qualification.
failure_dispositions.EXPECTED_SEMANTIC_NEGATIVE_INVALID: An expected-negative case lacks its exact FAILED Scheduler terminal, case-law frontier, sealed semantic receipt, explicit R3 binding, or terminal commit. Treat the request as ordinary failure; never publish VALID_NEGATIVE.
failure_dispositions.V1_IDENTITY_FAIL: Any qualified V1 profile, provider, route, estimator, checkpoint ABI, qualification key, or default compiled plan changes. Stop integration and restore the additive fence.
failure_dispositions.WAIT_RESOURCE: Live required compute capacity is temporarily occupied or below safe reserve. Preserve the same bound attempt and retry admission.

cases: Host and native field manifests match name, dtype, shape, aligned offset, byte size, total resident bytes, canonical checkpoint bytes, derived-cache bytes, event row and event bound.
Every canonical field perturbation changes the canonical digest; derived-cache deletion and reconstruction does not change it.
Checkpoint omission, unknown field, wrong route or ABI, truncation, torn seal and digest corruption fail closed.
Counter RNG addresses remain unique and exact at ticks 0, 1, 17 and the maximum admitted tick; generation, batch index, CTA, warp, lane and launch order are rejected as semantic inputs.
A separately implemented one-thread-per-world CUDA golden transition exercises all seven capabilities and publishes next_absolute_tick last.
A dispatch advances the acknowledged host frontier only after a sealed external sink receipt binds the exact event bytes, counts, world UIDs, tick span, artifact, and manifest.
gates.acceptance: All cases pass on one receipt-bound artifact identity; no CPU trajectory oracle or fallback is used.

Optimized CUDA matches the golden implementation for every canonical byte, reconstructed cache, capability counter, event row/address and terminal digest. A device failure cannot advance next_absolute_tick.

For every shape, both phase_graph_v2 and fused_cta_temporal_v2 are separately compiled and measured over that shape's own admitted B/K candidates; the selected result names the exact winning backend, B and K.

The same shape-specialized artifact can select K1 for the finest observation/checkpoint boundary or a larger admitted K for throughput; K changes dispatch interruption cadence and bounded event staging only, never absolute-tick, semantic-transition or checkpoint identity.
